subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep the shipped exit-78 supervised-lock behavior, adopt this PR's authenticated probe plus exit-0 behavior, or close/split this branch in favor of narrower current-main follow-up work?
rationale: The PR changes service-manager exit semantics and gateway auth probing in an area current main already solved differently, so automation cannot choose the product and upgrade contract safely.

options.title: Keep exit 78
options.body: Treat the shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

options.title: Adopt probe semantics
options.body: Approve the probe-based direction, but require a rebase plus real proof across shared-secret, trusted-proxy, TLS, and foreign-listener cases.

options.title: Split useful tests
options.body: Preserve only tests or docs that improve current-main behavior while dropping this branch's exit-code/auth-probe changes.

recommendation.title: Keep exit 78
recommendation.body: Treat the shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shipped current-main systemd EADDRINUSE fix that this PR would replace or alter.
